mentions.name: X11.Social
mentions.description: Voice-first content creation tool for X: users compose posts by having a natural conversation with an AI assistant over a simple phone call, turning thoughts from a walk or drive into polished "brain dump" posts. The system includes a Chrome extension with a Quake-style console (opt+space) that can chat and analyze the content of any page (YouTube transcripts, articles, tweets) to help create relevant content; a real-time engagement predictor that scores tweet drafts for engagement potential using a model trained on X API and Kaggle data; and scheduled AI calls that proactively brainstorm content ideas. Monetized with Stripe subscriptions, uses X OAuth, ElevenLabs Conversational AI and Twilio for voice, and is deployed on AWS Fargate.
mentions.problem: Composing posts on the go is hard — the tool addresses turning thoughts from a walk or drive into polished posts, or engaging with user lists without being at a computer.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on https://X11.Social, a voice-first content creation tool for X.

The initial idea was "call to tweet", the ability to compose posts on the go by having a natural conversation with an AI assistant over a simple phone call.
